name: A-Eye
tagline: Camera glasses that track obstacles and give blind users spoken directions indoors and out.
problem: Everyday navigation cues are visual and unavailable to blind people.
solution: YOLOv8 with persistent tracking finds obstacles, a focal-length formula estimates distance, and a server streams audio guidance to the wearer.
demo_moment: Team-described: walk toward a chair and a door handle while the glasses describe them.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “MLH: Best Use of ElevenLabs” among 307 submissions.
Tracking IDs suppress flicker before anything is spoken.

lessons: Stabilise detections before speaking; silence is better than a wrong warning.
